pronunciation: gwoh nyen (both with a falling-to-mid tone)
meaning: to celebrate the Lunar New Year; the New Year festival

example.hakka: 過年个時節,規家人都轉來食團圓飯。
example.romanization: Kwo-ngien ke sṳ̀-chiet, kuî-ka-ngìn tû chón-lòi sṳ̍t thòn-ién-fan.
example.english: At New Year, the whole family comes home to eat the reunion dinner.

note: 過年 is the biggest Hakka festival, and traditional preparations include making sweet rice cakes (甜粄) and turnip cakes (菜頭粄) to offer to the ancestors. In Hakka, 年 is pronounced ngièn, with the initial ng-, unlike Mandarin nián.
